medium: THE STAR WARS PILOT GAVE THE HERO A REASON TO KEEP MOVING WHEN THE PLAN FAILED.
A CAREFUL EDITOR USED THE STAR WARS PILOT TO CONNECT TWO VERY DIFFERENT SCENES.
THE STAR WARS PILOT LOOKED IMPOSSIBLE UNTIL THE CAMERA REVEALED THE PRACTICAL EFFECT.
VIEWERS DEBATED WHETHER THE STAR WARS PILOT WAS A CLUE OR A CLEVER DISTRACTION.
THE STAR WARS PILOT MADE THE QUIET MOMENT BEFORE THE FINALE FEEL IMPORTANT.
A MEMORABLE LINE FOLLOWED THE STAR WARS PILOT AND BECAME PART OF THE FAN LEXICON.
THE STAR WARS PILOT BROUGHT TOGETHER CHARACTERS WHO HAD NEVER SHARED A SCENE.
THE WRITERS SAVED THE STAR WARS PILOT FOR AN EPISODE THAT NEEDED A SURPRISE.
